en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3479 - Hammad narrated from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdullah (as), regarding a mukatab (a slave under a contract of emancipation) whose master stipulated that he should not marry without the master's permission until he fulfills his contract.
Imam (as) said: "He should not marry without the master's permission, for they have their condition."
